items.title: Ronnie Zito interviewed by Monk Rowe & Rick Montalbano, via Zoom, March 9, 2022
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Frankie Vallee and some of those high parts... [INTERVIEWEE] Where was this, where was this now?

ctx.x: All right? So all the tracks, everything is on the computer. They play but at some point you know like Frankie Vallee and some of those high parts, they just push up his track and that was that. And virtually every act that came through turned in that direction.
Where was this, where was this now?
